thread:
Elena P: Thanks for joining the AH Q&A. Capturing the live threads into a short follow-up so we can act quickly — owners noted below. Short comments only please.

Marco D: Live question: will Dedicated GA customers be able to set custom traffic-splitting rules per-route?

Priya S: Yes, per-route split rules are supported. Default is simple percentage-based splits but advanced rule syntax will be available (geo, customer-tier). I'll add an example JSON and a brief explainer in the docs.

Ben K: Ops question from the thread: when a canary is running, what's the expected alerting cadence and who gets paged if latency regresses?

Elena P: During canary: infra alerts to oncall infra first, then product owner if error thresholds sustained >5 minutes. We'll include exact thresholds in the runbook. Jordan (not in thread) will own the paging matrix.

Alice Y: QA note: we'll run a small golden prompt set against the canary every hour. If any critical prompt drops >6% we'll escalate to ML/product. Need to know where to pull the prompt list from.

Marco D: I'll publish the sample split JSON tonight and add a short example for geo-based rules. Link will be in the follow-up doc.

Priya S: Owners I'm taking: docs snippet + example JSON.

Ben K: Taking runbook thresholds and alert routing. I'll add the 5-minute sustained window and error_rate>1.5% as an initial threshold.

Alice Y: Taking the golden prompt set and alert hooks. Uploading prompts to evals infra.

deploy-bot: canary job scheduled for 2024-05-06T18:00Z on branch 'dedicated-ga-canary' (sha: c9f8b2a). Smoke tests will run post-deploy.

Elena P: Consolidated owner list and action checklist:
- Priya S: per-route split docs + JSON example (docs repo)
- Marco D: geo & tier rule examples + internal snippet link
- Ben K: canary runbook thresholds + paging matrix
- Alice Y: golden prompt set + eval alert config
- Elena P: announcement copy and comms plan

Small sample split JSON for docs:
```
{
  "route": "/chat",
  "split_rules": [
    {"percent": 80, "variant": "v2", "filter": "region:us-*"},
    {"percent": 20, "variant": "v2-quantized", "filter": "region:eu-* || tier:trial"}
  ]
}
```

Elena P: Please reply "claimed" when you pick your item so I can track. Will send final announcement once at least PRs + runbook are merged. Thanks :raised_hands:

Priya S: claimed (posting docs PR link when ready).

Marco D: claimed (publishing example snip to internal snippets repo).

Ben K: claimed (runbook draft in progress).

Alice Y: claimed (uploading prompts now).

Elena P: Great. I'll assemble the follow-up note and ping comms for a short announcement window.
